page.overview:
What is Rockstar Animatronics?

The Rockstar Animatronics are another set of revamped animatronic models from the Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place location by Fazbear Entertainment.

They first appeared in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator as purchasable items from the Smiles and Servos, Inc Catalog (except for Lefty, who can be afforded from Rare Finds Auction, and Carnie, who debuted in another game) for customizing the pizzeria. They would later make reappearances in Ultimate Custom Night and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2.

The rockstar animatronics seem to be based off the classic animatronics in their withered forms. They all have heads separated from the jaws, sporting round rosy or blue cheeks (except Rockstar Foxy), metal stars on their chests (except for Rockstar Chica who wears a bib, and Carnie who wears a suit), and equip instruments.

While full details of their artificial intelligence are not revealed, it is possible that the rockstar animatronics have their own unique functions, like Rockstar Freddy designed as a Faz-Coin bank seen in Ultimate Custom Night.
